flags.message: The interim amicus counter undercounts: the committed 2026-08-24 snapshot shows 13 amicus filings on 26A124 before disposition, but the frozen context and outcome.json both record amicus_briefs = 6 — exactly the entries captioned singular 'Brief amicus curiae', suggesting the counter misses the 7 plural 'Brief amici curiae' entries. Two candidates reported this independently and I verified it against the snapshot. It contaminates the amicus-increment claim's conditioning state and resolution (frozen 6 vs outcome 6 reads as no increment while 13 briefs existed throughout), so the harness-computed claim_scores row for amicus-increment on this event should be read with caution.
